test_title: PYST 68: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** Some sandals are crocs. All crocs are flipflops.

**Conclusion I:** Some sandals are flipflops.

**Conclusion II: **All flipflops are crocs.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

Some sandals are crocs.**
All crocs are flipflops.

**Venn Diagram Logic:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c925667d1d88577bb41f4ad76b63b703277f377104a6b4fa2dd566490b9b71d.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some sandals are flipflops: Follows **(Because some sandals are crocs and all crocs are flipflops.Therefore, some sandals are definitely flipflops.)

(II) All flipflops are crocs: **Does not follows **(The statement says “All crocs are flipflops”, but it does not mean all flipflops are crocs.)

Therefore, only Conclusion I follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".**
